highlights.excerpt:
We’re renaming our Max plans: 

Max 5x → Max
Max 20x → Ultra

Max is still $100/month, and Ultra is still $200. If you’re a subscriber, there’s nothing you need to do.

We’re also removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting today with most existing subscribers.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我们正在重命名 Max 套餐：Max 5x → Max，Max 20x → Ultra。Max 仍为每月 100 美元，Ultra 仍为 200 美元。我们还将取消已验证 Ultra 账户的 5 小时限额。
highlights.name: Claude
highlights.text_zh: Claude 改名订阅档：Max 5x→Max、Max 20x→Ultra，价格不变；已验证 Ultra 取消 5 小时限额。

highlights.excerpt:
A ‘hello world’ milestone for Project Suncatcher 🚀

After launching our prototype satellite a few weeks ago, we’ve now successfully sent a command up to orbit, booted up the TPU, ran the prompt, and received our first complete response back on earth - a haiku! https://t.co/kOFmETUskm
highlights.excerpt_zh: Project Suncatcher 的「hello world」里程碑🚀：几周前发射原型卫星后，我们已成功向轨道发送指令、启动 TPU、运行提示词，并在地球上收到首个完整响应——一首俳句！
highlights.name: Sundar Pichai
highlights.text_zh: Google Project Suncatcher：轨道 TPU 已成功回传首个提示响应（一首俳句）。

highlights.excerpt:
I thought it was just a proposal, but it actually passed 🤯

France will charge €0.055 per GB on all internet traffic! https://t.co/mfiiPnttK2
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我以为这只是提案，结果真的通过了🤯 法国将对所有互联网流量按每 GB 收取 €0.055！
highlights.name: Pieter Levels
highlights.text_zh: 法国将通过按流量计费：每 GB 收 €0.055；Pieter 称原以为只是提案现已通过。

highlights.excerpt:
Saw a few discussions about size of hack, why impact to bitcoin price is small, etc. 👇 

$6.3 billion is the biggest in USD terms, but not in BTC terms. MtGox was 650,000 BTC!

Other important numbers to consider:

% of bitcoin (in relation to BTC total supply), ie, market impact.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 63 亿美元按美元计是最大的，但按 BTC 计仍不及 MtGox（65 万枚 BTC）！还需看占 BTC 总量比例、受影响用户数，以及用户资产占比。
highlights.name: CZ 🔶 BNB
highlights.text_zh: CZ：本次黑客约 63 亿美元为美元口径最大，但 BTC 口径仍逊于 MtGox；强调用户占比与市场冲击。

highlights.excerpt: We're removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts. https://t.co/CewlkJkBmj
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我们将取消已验证 Ultra 账户的 5 小时限额。
highlights.name: Boris Cherny
highlights.text_zh: Boris：已验证 Ultra 账户取消 5 小时限额（与 Claude 改名同步）。

highlights.excerpt: I believe the greatest gift you can give your kids is a calm home. It’s not the big house or the best toys that stick with them. It’s a place where they feel safe. Where mistakes are met with patience. Where voices stay low. Where hard conversations are always followed by repair.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我认为你能给孩子最好的礼物是一个平静的家。不是大房子或最好的玩具让他们记住，而是一个他们感到安全的地方：犯错被耐心对待、声音保持低沉、艰难对话之后总会修复。
highlights.name: Sahil Bloom
highlights.text_zh: Sahil：给孩子最好的礼物是平静的家——安全、耐心、低声量、冲突后能修复。

highlights.excerpt:
User funds are safe. 

Binance will cover all hacking losses.

Deposits and withdrawals are temporarily suspended while our team conducts security checks, freezes funds, and works with law enforcement.

We will share a full post-mortem once the investigation is complete.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 用户资金安全。Binance 将覆盖全部黑客损失。团队进行安全检查、冻结资金并配合执法期间，充值与提现暂时暂停。
highlights.name: Yi He
highlights.text_zh: Binance Yi He：用户资金安全，平台将覆盖全部黑客损失；充提暂停并配合执法。

highlights.excerpt: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplace, impacting at most 5,000 users. This malicious version of the extension was not developed by Anthropic. It does not impact other extensions
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我们发现一起安全事件：经 Cursor IDE 扩展市场获取的被篡改 Claude Code VS Code 扩展，最多影响约 5000 用户。该恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发，也不影响其他扩展。
highlights.name: Cursor
highlights.text_zh: Cursor：市场里被篡改的 Claude Code 扩展致安全事件，最多约 5000 用户；非 Anthropic 官方。

summary_zh: Binance 遭重大黑客，Yi He/CZ 称将全额覆盖用户损失；美元口径约 63 亿。
Claude 改名 Max/Ultra 并取消已验证 Ultra 的 5 小时限额；Cursor 曝 Claude Code 扩展遭篡改。
Google Suncatcher：轨道 TPU 回传首个提示响应；话题 Claude Code +27%。
